notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an additional creature.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Warehouse Tabby triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
